work.label: 01 — Selected work
work.title: Three projects, built end to end.

intelisoft.title: AI chatbot for enterprise data
intelisoft.body: Designed and built end to end with the OpenAI API. It combines semantic search with structured queries to answer questions and generate reports automatically. Now deploying on Azure.

candelasoft.title: Control interfaces for robots and vision models
candelasoft.body: Web control interfaces for robotic arms and computer-vision models, packaged with Electron for Linux, macOS and Windows. REST plus real-time protocols, on a hexagonal FastAPI backend shared by the robotics, AI and dev teams.

akontrol.title: A full product redesign, solo
akontrol.body: Figma UI, React frontend, FastAPI backend, database design and CI/CD with Docker on Railway and AWS, all delivered by one person.

aiDemo.title: Ask my portfolio.
aiDemo.body: A small RAG assistant over my CV, projects and paper, built with OpenAI and [vector DB]. Try a question and see which sources it cites.
aiDemo.sampleQuestion: What has Santiago shipped with LLMs?
aiDemo.sampleAnswer: He designed and built an OpenAI-powered chatbot that mixes semantic search with structured queries to answer questions and generate reports, and integrated computer-vision models into industrial control interfaces.
